name: billiardclub-bridge
description: Billiard Club — klub tarmog'ida ishlaydigan chiroq boshqaruvi bridge agenti (majburiy npm bog'liqliklarsiz)

scripts.check: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');const {execFileSync}=require('child_process');const files=['agent.js',...fs.readdirSync('lib').filter(f=>f.endsWith('.js')).map(f=>path.join('lib',f)),...fs.readdirSync('lib/drivers').filter(f=>f.endsWith('.js')).map(f=>path.join('lib','drivers',f))];for(const f of files)execFileSync(process.execPath,['--check',f],{stdio:'inherit'});console.log('check ok: '+files.length+' fayl')"
